subject: Re: Production demo — request for short buffer to complete dry-run & sample ingest
body:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tracy Li <tracy.li@finlytics.com>, Sam Patel <sam.patel@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Production demo — request for short buffer to complete dry-run & sample ingest

Hi Tracy / Sam,

Quick note — Marcus (SE) and I reviewed the access request you sent. To do a meaningful production walkthrough that exercises your workload traces and the prompt sets you described, we need a short technical dry-run and to ingest the pseudonymized sample dataset into a staging bucket.

Would you be open to a 48-hour buffer so Marcus can:
- run the dry-run against a small slice of your traces,
- validate tokenization/length distributions against the model variant we'll demo, and
- confirm the sample data mapping in our staging environment?

If moving the live demo is hard, we can also do a split plan: keep the customer-facing session for the executive overview, then schedule a separate hands-on technical session for the deep dive with Marcus and your ops folks.

Proposed options (all PT):
- Option A: Move demo to Thu 17 Dec, 10:00–11:00 PT (preferred)
- Option B: Keep Thu 15 Dec 14:00–15:00 PT as planned and add technical dry-run Wed 16 Dec 09:00–10:00 PT
- Option C: Split — executive demo Thu 15 Dec 14:00–14:30 PT; tech deep-dive Thu 15 Dec 15:00–16:00 PT

Marcus has attached a short runbook and a checklist for the sample ingest. Laura / Neha — can you hold the windows above on my calendar tentatively and loop in calendar invites once Tracy confirms?

Thanks — Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Engineer (Growth)
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

-----Original Message-----
From: Tracy Li <tracy.li@finlytics.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam.patel@finlytics.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:01:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Production demo — request for short buffer to complete dry-run & sample ingest

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the heads-up. We appreciate the attention to the technical details — given the complexity of our traces and the fact that two of our engineers are traveling, a short buffer makes sense.

Two quick constraints from our side:
1) Sam is on a red-eye flight Wed night and won't be available until Thu afternoon PT.
2) Our security team needs to review the ingest checklist before we hand over any S3 presigned links (they prefer a one-time presigned URL scoped to the demo bucket).

Assuming you mean Thu 17 Dec (your Option A), that would work for us. If you instead mean Thu 15 Dec in Option B/C I think that will be tight for Sam.

We can provide a presigned URL for a 48-hour window once your team confirms the target prefix. I'll get the security note started and copy ops.

—Tracy
VP, Platform Engineering
Finlytics
tracy.li@finlytics.com | +1 (650) 555-0127

-----Original Message-----
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tracy Li <tracy.li@finlytics.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Production demo — request for short buffer to complete dry-run & sample ingest

Thanks Tracy — appreciate the constraints. To be concrete about what we need from Finlytics:  
- A presigned S3 URL scoped to s3://finlytics-demo/staging/ (or a shareable link to a secure bucket).
- A small representative CSV (<= 2000 rows) and one representative workload trace (JSONL) — our checklist calls these: pseudo_financials.csv and traces_sample.jsonl.
- If there are PII concerns, send a pseudonymized export (we can provide a script to help).

Attachments: runbook-demo-steps.pdf (step-by-step dry-run), sample-ingest-checklist.md (fields we validate).

If we get the files by Wed 16 Dec 11:00 PT Marcus can run the ingest and validation and report back by Wed 16 17:00 PT, which makes Thu 17 Dec 10:00 PT a safe slot for the full demo.

If you can't share data that early, we can proceed with the executive overview and do the technical walkthrough once the data is available.

Cheers,
Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0244

-----Original Message-----
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tracy Li <tracy.li@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 11:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Production demo — request for short buffer to complete dry-run & sample ingest

Perfect — thanks Tracy. We'll tentatively move to Option A (Thu 17 Dec, 10:00–11:00 PT). Laura / Neha, please send calendar invites and include a separate invite for the tech dry-run if we need one on Wed 16 Dec 09:00–10:00 PT (tentative).

Tracy / Sam — once you share the presigned URL I'll forward to Marcus and he'll confirm the ingest window. If your security team wants a quick checklist review call, Marcus can be available Wed morning.

Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Engineer (Growth)
Redwood Inference

From: Tracy Li <tracy.li@finlytics.com>

Cc: Sam Patel <sam.patel@finlytics.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Production demo — request for short buffer to complete dry-run & sample ingest

Jordan — confirming Thu 17 Dec 10:00–11:00 PT works for the full demo.

I generated a presigned URL for a scoped folder: https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/finlytics-samples/pseudo_financials-2026-12-14.csv?presigned=true (48 hours). Security has reviewed the checklist and is comfortable with the pseudonymized file we uploaded.

I'll accept the calendar invite and add Sam once he's landed. If Marcus wants to run the dry-run Wed morning, say 09:00 PT, we're OK to stand that up.

Thanks — Tracy

--
Tracy Li
VP, Platform Engineering
Finlytics
